geospatialSolutions.title: GEOSAPATIAL SOLUTIONS
geospatialSolutions.description: Transform location data into meaningful intelligence using Esri technology, revealing patterns, opportunities and smarter ways forward.
detailedDescription: iTechs Arabia delivers advanced geospatial solutions that help organisations better understand their assets, operations and environments through location intelligence. By combining geographic information systems, real-time data, digital mapping and spatial analytics, we transform complex information into clear, actionable insights.

Our solutions support urban planning, infrastructure and asset management, environmental monitoring, logistics, public safety, emergency response and field operations—helping organisations make informed decisions.

items: Disaster management and emergency response organisations
Urban planning and smart city development authorities
Environmental and natural resource management agencies

securitySolutions.title: SECURITY SOLUTIONS
securitySolutions.description: Security solutions are designed to protect critical infrastructure, facilities and urban environments through advanced surveillance, access control and integrated monitoring systems.
detailedDescription: As digital environments become increasingly connected, organisations need security solutions that are proactive, intelligent and resilient. iTechs Arabia provides comprehensive security solutions covering networks, applications, data, endpoints and critical infrastructure.

Our specialists assess vulnerabilities, identify potential threats and recommend the technologies and processes required to strengthen security across the organisation. From prevention and continuous monitoring to threat detection, digital investigation and incident response, we help clients protect their critical assets and maintain operational continuity.

integrationServicesIot.title: INTEGRATION SERVICES AND IoT
integrationServicesIot.description: Bringing technologies, infrastructure and people together within one seamless operational ecosystem.
detailedDescription: Our integration and IoT solutions connect physical assets with digital platforms, providing organisations with real-time visibility into their environments and operations.

digitalTwin.title: DIGITAL TWIN
digitalTwin.description: A digital twin is a real-time virtual replica of a physical asset, system, or environment that enables continuous monitoring, analysis, and optimisation.
detailedDescription: iTechs Arabia develops advanced digital twin solutions that create dynamic, real-time 3D replicas of physical assets, infrastructure and environments. Built with Unity and GIS, the solutions are continuously enriched with live IoT, operational and historical data.

Using real-time data integration and simulation, the digital twin provides an accurate live view of assets and operations. It supports monitoring, historical trends, alerts and interactive visualisation, while enabling organisations to test scenarios, assess risks and predict potential failures before they occur.

From smart buildings and industrial facilities to transportation networks and urban environments, our digital twin solutions help organisations improve operational efficiency, reduce downtime, enhance safety and make faster, data-driven decisions.

planningTrainingSimulation.title: PLANNING, TRAINING & SIMULATION
planningTrainingSimulation.description: Plan smarter, train realistically and validate critical decisions before they are implemented in the field.
detailedDescription: The iTechs Arabia Planning, Training & Simulation platform is a geospatially enabled system developed to support planning, terrain analysis, scenario development, training and performance evaluation.

The platform allows officers, commanders and trainees to study terrain, assess tactical conditions and compare different operational alternatives within a secure digital environment. Plans can be developed, visualised and simulated before implementation, allowing users to evaluate their effectiveness and understand the potential consequences of each decision.

The system also supports decision-makers across strategic, operational and tactical levels by creating a centralised information environment that can integrate with existing or future systems. Its flexible architecture enables the platform to evolve alongside operational requirements and emerging technologies.

workforceManagement.title: WORKFORCE MANAGEMENT
workforceManagement.description: Turn every request, task and field team into one connected, visible and measurable service operation.
detailedDescription: iTechs Arabia’s Workforce Management platform connects service requests, supervisors, field teams and operational data within one unified digital environment.

The platform enables organisations to receive requests, assign tasks, monitor employees and contractors, track service progress and verify completion in real time. Through GIS-enabled dispatching, mobile workforce applications and centralised dashboards, managers gain full visibility over who is working, where they are located and how effectively each task is being completed.

Our business analysts work closely with every client to understand their existing processes, identify operational gaps and map the complete service journey. Based on this analysis, we configure the platform’s workflows, task categories, escalation rules, performance indicators and dashboards to match the organisation’s actual requirements rather than forcing teams to follow a standardised process.

artilleryTacticalOperationNavigation.title: ARTILLERY TACTICAL OPERATION NAVIGATION
artilleryTacticalOperationNavigation.description: A connected artillery planning, navigation and fire-control environment designed to strengthen coordination, visibility and operational precision.
detailedDescription: Artillery Tactical Operation & Navigation, or ATON, is an integrated artillery planning, management and fire-control platform developed to support the coordination of artillery units and assets within one secure operational environment.

The system connects commanders, platoon leaders, forward observers and weapon units, enabling them to exchange operational information and maintain a shared understanding of missions, assets, terrain and field conditions.

ATON combines geospatial analysis, artillery asset management, mission planning, navigation, fire-control support and operational reporting. It helps commanders assess terrain, identify appropriate positions and routes, coordinate available resources and maintain visibility over developing operations.
